in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (Deva, God) + इन्द्र (Indra, King of Gods) + सिंह (Lion)

in_marathi.name: Devendrasinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devendrasinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devendra means the lord of gods and Sinh means lion. So, Devendrasinh means the god who is the lord of all gods and has the strength of a lion.

in_bengali.name: Devendrasinh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Gods
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devendrasinh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Devendra means the lord of gods and Sinh means lion. So, Devendrasinh means the god who is the lord of all gods and has the strength of a lion.
